title.description: REQUIRED for create_reminder, save_memory and forget_memory: short name, e.g. DBMS exam

detail.description: Optional extra info for a memory

triggerAt.description: create_reminder ONLY. ISO-8601 with the user's offset, e.g. 2026-10-05T09:00:00+05:30

rrule.description: Required when the user says every day/week/month. FREQ=DAILY, FREQ=WEEKLY or FREQ=MONTHLY;BYMONTHDAY=n

priority.description: IMPORTANT for payments, EMIs, bills, exams and deadlines

expiresInHours.description: save_memory with memoryKind TEMPORARY: hours until it can be forgotten

note.description: log_expense ONLY: what the money was for
